function encodeCursor(offset) {
  return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({offset})).toString('base64');
}

  try {
    const decoded = Buffer.from(cursor, 'base64').toString('utf-8');
    const parsed = JSON.parse(decoded);
    if (typeof parsed.offset !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(parsed.offset) || parsed.offset < 0 || parsed.offset > events.length) {

  }

      },

    }
  }];

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  if (name !== 'events_list') {
    throw new Error('Unknown tool');

  const allowed = new Set(['cursor', 'page_size']);
  for (const key of Object.keys(args)) {

      throw new Error(`Unknown field: ${key}`);
    }
  }
  
  const pageSize = args.page_size === undefined ? 2 : args.page_size;
  if (!Number.isInteger(pageSize) || pageSize < 1 || pageSize > 3) {
    throw new Error('page_size must be an integer between 1 and 3');
  }
  
  let offset = 0;
  if (args.cursor !== undefined) {
    if (typeof args.cursor !== 'string') {
      throw new Error('cursor must be a string');
    }
    offset = decodeCursor(args.cursor);
  }
  
  const page = events.slice(offset, offset + pageSize);
  const nextOffset = offset + pageSize;
  const response = { events: page };
  if (nextOffset < events.length) {
    response.next_cursor = encodeCursor(nextOffset);
  }
  
  return {
    content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify(response) }]
  };
}
